title: Seat selection charged twice on one booking
context: Booking QK7742, two passengers, seat selection 24.00 per passenger. The card statement shows four charges of 24.00. The booking record lists two seat products. The agent can refund the two unmatched charges and cannot alter the fare.
customer_turns: On booking QK7742 I paid twice for seat selection. There are four charges of twenty-four pounds on my card but only two of us are travelling.
The page timed out when I first selected the seats and I went through it again. Your confirmation email lists two seats, not four, so the extra pair bought nothing.
Refund the two charges that have no seat against them. Confirm the amount and when it lands before we finish, because I am travelling on Friday.
resolution_space: Refund the two unmatched seat charges
Raise a payment investigation before refunding
Issue travel credit of equivalent value
Escalate to the payments team

title: Resort fee not shown at booking
context: Hotel reservation HR-55810, four nights, prepaid. A mandatory resort fee of 22.00 per night was collected at the property. The booking page disclosed the fee in the property terms but not in the headline total. The agent can refund the fee as a booking-display remedy.
customer_turns: I prepaid reservation HR-55810 for four nights and the hotel still charged me eighty-eight pounds in resort fees at check-in. That was never in the price I agreed.
I have the confirmation email and the total on it matches what I paid you. There is no line anywhere on it about a nightly fee of any kind.
Either refund the eighty-eight pounds or tell me clearly that I agreed to it and where. I want a decision on this call.
resolution_space: Refund the resort fee as a booking-display remedy
Explain the property terms disclosure and decline the refund
Offer partial credit toward a future booking
Escalate to the hotel partnerships team

title: Baggage charged at the gate despite an included allowance
context: Booking ZR2298 on a fare that includes one 23 kg checked bag. A gate bag fee of 65.00 was taken. The boarding pass printed without the bag indicator because of a check-in system fault logged that morning. The agent can refund the gate fee.
customer_turns: I was charged sixty-five pounds at the gate for a bag on booking ZR2298, even though my fare includes a checked bag of twenty-three kilos.
The staff member said my boarding pass did not show a bag allowance, so I paid to avoid missing the flight. My booking clearly lists the bag.
I want the sixty-five pounds returned. Tell me how long it takes and whether I need to send you the receipt from the airport desk.
resolution_space: Refund the gate bag fee against the fare inclusion
Request the gate receipt before refunding
Issue an equivalent travel voucher
Escalate to the airport services team

title: Currency conversion applied against the customer's choice
context: Booking MN3390 priced in euros. The customer chose to pay in euros; the payment settled in pounds through the merchant conversion option at a rate 4 percent above interbank, costing about 31.00 extra. The agent can refund the conversion difference as goodwill.
customer_turns: On booking MN3390 I chose to pay in euros and my card was billed in pounds at a poor rate. It has cost me roughly thirty pounds more than it should.
I remember the currency choice screen and I selected euros deliberately, because my card handles conversion better than any merchant rate does.
Refund the difference caused by converting against my choice. If you cannot do that, say so and tell me who can, so I can take it further.
resolution_space: Refund the conversion difference as goodwill
Provide the payment record showing the currency selected
Decline and refer the customer to the card issuer
Escalate to the payments team

title: Change fee charged on a flexible fare
context: Booking TP1165 on a flexible fare with free date changes and a fare difference payable. A 45.00 change fee plus a 12.00 fare difference were taken. The fare rules confirm no change fee applies. The agent can refund the 45.00.
customer_turns: I moved my flight on booking TP1165 and was charged a forty-five pound change fee plus twelve pounds of fare difference. I bought the flexible fare.
I accept the twelve pounds for the price difference, that is fair. It is the change fee I am disputing, because flexible is supposed to mean no fee.
Refund the forty-five and leave the twelve alone. Confirm that is exactly what you are doing before we end this call, and send it in writing.
resolution_space: Refund the change fee and retain the fare difference
Refund both amounts as goodwill
Review the fare rules before deciding
Escalate to the fares team

title: Car hire deposit not released
context: Car hire booking CH-40027, completed eighteen days ago. A 250.00 security deposit hold remains on the card. The supplier releases holds within ten working days. No damage was recorded at return. The agent can instruct release and cannot move the funds directly.
customer_turns: My car hire booking CH-40027 finished eighteen days ago and the two hundred and fifty pound deposit is still held on my card.
The car was returned with a clean inspection sheet, which I have a copy of, and nobody has contacted me about damage or fuel since.
Get the hold released. Tell me exactly what you can do and by when, because this is money I need available for the rest of the trip.
resolution_space: Instruct the supplier to release the hold with a stated deadline
Provide the inspection record and confirm no charges are pending
Advise the customer to request release through the card issuer
Escalate to the car hire supplier team

title: Refund for a cancelled flight not received
context: Booking LD8801, flight cancelled by the airline thirty-one days ago, refund of 412.00 approved at the time. Published refund turnaround is fourteen days. The refund is queued but unprocessed. The agent can escalate for manual processing.
customer_turns: My flight on booking LD8801 was cancelled by you thirty-one days ago and the four hundred and twelve pound refund has still not arrived.
I was told fourteen days on the call when it was cancelled. I have checked the card the refund was taken from and there is nothing on it.
Process it manually if that is what it takes, and give me a date. I would rather have a real date than another estimate.
resolution_space: Push the refund for manual processing with a committed date
Confirm the refund destination and reissue if misdirected
Offer travel credit as an immediate alternative
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Delayed baggage not returned after four days
context: Property irregularity report PIR-LHR-33902, filed four days ago. The bag is traced to a partner airline's warehouse and awaits a delivery slot. Policy allows an interim expense allowance of up to 100.00. The agent can approve the allowance and arrange courier delivery.
customer_turns: My bag has been missing for four days under report PIR-LHR-33902. The tracker has said located and awaiting delivery for two of those days.
I am here for a wedding on Saturday and everything I need is in it. I have already bought a few essentials out of my own pocket.
Tell me when it will reach me and what I can claim back for the things I have had to buy while waiting for it.
resolution_space: Arrange courier delivery with a committed window
Approve the interim expense allowance
Provide written confirmation for an insurance claim
Escalate to the baggage services team

title: Hotel confirmation never issued
context: Reservation request HT-71140 placed six days ago; payment taken, no confirmation number issued because the property has not returned an acknowledgement. Check-in is in three days. The agent can rebook at a comparable property or cancel with a full refund.
customer_turns: I booked reservation HT-71140 six days ago and paid in full, but I have never received a confirmation number from the hotel itself.
I called the property directly and they have no record of me at all. We arrive in three days and this is our only accommodation.
Either get me a confirmed room or cancel and refund me today. I need to know which before I book something else.
resolution_space: Rebook at a comparable property at no extra cost
Cancel with a full refund
Obtain confirmation from the property within a stated window
Escalate to the hotel partnerships team

title: Airport transfer did not arrive
context: Transfer booking TR-29014 for a 06:10 pickup; the driver did not arrive and the customer paid 78.00 for a taxi. The supplier log shows no driver assigned. The agent can refund the transfer and reimburse the taxi up to the transfer value plus 50 percent.
customer_turns: My airport transfer TR-29014 was booked for ten past six and no driver came. I waited twenty-five minutes and then took a taxi for seventy-eight pounds.
I called the number on the voucher twice and it rang out both times. I could not risk missing the flight, so I stopped waiting.
Refund the transfer and cover the taxi fare. Tell me what you will actually pay before I send you the receipt and the booking reference.
resolution_space: Refund the transfer and reimburse the taxi within the policy cap
Refund the transfer only
Request the supplier's driver log before deciding
Escalate to the ground transport team

title: Rescheduled flight leaves no connection time
context: Booking AG5520, outbound retimed two hours later by the airline, leaving 35 minutes to a self-transfer onward flight booked separately. Minimum connection time at the airport is 75 minutes. The agent can rebook the retimed leg free of charge on a schedule change.
customer_turns: You have moved my outbound on booking AG5520 two hours later. That leaves me thirty-five minutes to catch a separate onward flight.
The airport itself asks for seventy-five minutes between flights, so this connection is not possible. The onward ticket is with a different airline.
Put me on an earlier flight that keeps the connection working. If nothing exists, tell me what my other options are, including a full refund.
resolution_space: Rebook onto an earlier flight free of charge under the schedule change
Refund the affected leg in full
Offer the next day's flight with accommodation
Escalate to the schedule change team

title: Visa support letter not issued before travel
context: Booking VS-60912. A visa support letter was requested eleven days ago; the standard issue time is five working days. The request failed validation because the passport name field contained an unsupported character. The agent can reissue within one working day.
customer_turns: I asked for a visa support letter for booking VS-60912 eleven days ago and nothing has come. Your site says five working days.
My appointment at the consulate is on Monday and they will not see me without it. My passport name has an accented character, if that is relevant.
Get the letter to me before Monday. Tell me now whether that is possible so I can move the appointment if not.
resolution_space: Reissue the letter within one working day with the corrected field
Provide an interim booking confirmation letter today
Advise rebooking the consulate appointment
Escalate to the documentation team

title: Online check-in fails for one passenger
context: Booking RW4418, three passengers. Check-in completes for two and fails for the third with a document-verification error; the stored passport expiry is in the past. The agent can update the document and complete check-in.
customer_turns: Online check-in on booking RW4418 works for two of us and fails for my son every time. It gives an error about document verification.
He has a new passport issued in July, so whatever you hold for him is probably the old one. The new number is on the letter in front of me.
Update his details and check him in with us. I want all three boarding passes before I put the phone down, not later by email.
resolution_space: Update the passport details and complete check-in
Direct the passenger to airport check-in with documents
Reissue the booking with corrected passenger data
Escalate to the check-in systems team

title: Booking not visible in the account
context: Booking YH7703 was made as a guest with an email address differing by one character from the account email. The booking exists and is valid. The agent can attach the booking to the account after verification.
customer_turns: I made booking YH7703 last month and it does not appear anywhere in my account. I can see older trips but not this one.
I might have checked out as a guest rather than signing in. The confirmation did arrive, but at an address very close to the one on my account.
Attach it to my account so I can manage it myself. Confirm that it is genuinely booked while you are looking at it.
resolution_space: Verify identity and attach the booking to the account
Resend the confirmation to the account email
Advise managing the booking through the guest link
Escalate to the account services team

title: Loyalty number not credited for a flown flight
context: Booking KP2214, flown eighteen days ago. The loyalty number was added after ticketing and did not pass to the flight coupon. Retroactive credit is available within six months with a boarding pass or ticket number. The agent can submit the claim.
customer_turns: I flew on booking KP2214 eighteen days ago and no miles have appeared in my loyalty account. My number was on the booking when I checked in.
I added the number after I had already paid, which may be why it did not follow through. I still have my boarding pass in the app.
Claim the miles for me now. Tell me how long they take to show and whether I need to send anything in, such as the boarding pass.
resolution_space: Submit a retroactive credit claim with the ticket number
Ask the customer to submit the claim through the loyalty portal
Add the loyalty number to the profile for future bookings
Escalate to the loyalty programme team

title: Mobile boarding pass will not load
context: Booking DN6631. The boarding pass fails to render in the app for a codeshare segment operated by a partner airline; partner segments require check-in on the operating carrier. The agent can direct the passenger and can email a printable pass where available.
customer_turns: The boarding pass for booking DN6631 will not load in your app. It spins and then shows a blank screen every time I open it.
It is the second leg that fails; the first one is fine. The second flight is apparently operated by a different airline under your flight number.
Get me something I can show at the gate. Email it if the app will not work, but I need it before I leave for the airport.
resolution_space: Email a printable boarding pass for the partner segment
Direct the passenger to check in with the operating carrier
Arrange airport desk check-in for the second leg
Escalate to the digital services team

title: Seat map shows seats already paid for as unassigned
context: Booking FQ9982. Two paid extra-legroom seats show as unassigned after an aircraft change from a wide-body to a narrow-body layout. Equivalent seats exist in row 1. The agent can reassign or refund the seat charge.
customer_turns: The seat map for booking FQ9982 shows both of our paid extra-legroom seats as unassigned. We paid ninety pounds for those seats at booking.
I think the aircraft has been changed, because the layout looks different from when we booked. Our original row numbers do not exist any more.
Put us in equivalent seats together, or refund the ninety pounds. I would much prefer the seats if any still exist on the aircraft.
resolution_space: Reassign equivalent extra-legroom seats together
Refund the seat charge
Assign standard seats together with a partial refund
Escalate to the seating team

title: Booking modification page returns an error
context: Booking GS1187 contains a special assistance request, which locks self-service modification. The customer wants to add a bag. The agent can add the bag directly at the online price.
customer_turns: Every time I try to add a bag to booking GS1187 your website gives an error and sends me back to the start of the page.
I have tried on a laptop and a phone, and on two browsers. The booking has a wheelchair assistance request on it, if that changes anything.
Add a twenty-three kilo bag for me at the online price. I do not want to pay the airport rate because your page will not work.
resolution_space: Add the bag directly at the online price
Provide a payment link for the online-priced bag
Remove the modification lock and let the customer retry
Escalate to the bookings systems team

title: Cancelling within twenty-four hours of booking
context: Booking BV3345, made nineteen hours ago, fare 286.00, departure in six weeks. The 24-hour cancellation policy allows a full refund. The agent can cancel and refund in full.
customer_turns: I booked flight BV3345 nineteen hours ago for two hundred and eighty-six pounds and I need to cancel. The trip is not going ahead.
I understand fares are usually non-refundable, but I believe there is a twenty-four hour window and I am inside it by a few hours.
Cancel it and refund the full amount. Confirm the figure and the timescale before we finish, so I have it on record today.
resolution_space: Cancel with a full refund under the 24-hour policy
Cancel with a refund less taxes only
Hold the booking value as a credit
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Cancelling a non-refundable hotel for a medical reason
context: Reservation HR-90023, non-refundable, 410.00 paid, check-in in nine days. A documented medical reason applies. The agent can request a property waiver and can issue credit but cannot refund unilaterally.
customer_turns: I need to cancel reservation HR-90023 for four hundred and ten pounds. I have had surgery scheduled for the same week as the trip.
I know I booked the non-refundable rate. I have a letter from the hospital confirming the date if that helps the case at all.
Ask the hotel to waive it. If they refuse, tell me what else you can offer rather than just closing the case.
resolution_space: Request a property waiver with the medical documentation
Issue travel credit toward a future stay
Change the dates instead of cancelling
Escalate to the hotel partnerships team

title: Refund of taxes on an unused ticket
context: Booking CE4471, non-refundable fare of 190.00, flight not taken. Government taxes and airport charges of 44.60 are refundable on unused tickets, less a 20.00 administration fee. The agent can process the tax refund.
customer_turns: I missed my flight on booking CE4471 and did not travel. The fare was one hundred and ninety pounds and non-refundable, which I accept.
Someone told me the taxes on an unused ticket can still be returned, because the airport charges were never actually incurred by anyone.
Refund whatever part of it I am entitled to. Tell me the exact figure after any fee you take off it, before I agree.
resolution_space: Process the tax refund less the administration fee
Refund taxes in full as goodwill
Decline on the basis of the fare rules
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Cancelling one passenger from a group booking
context: Booking TG7788 for four passengers on a semi-flexible fare. One passenger cannot travel. Removing a passenger costs a 40.00 fee and may reprice the remaining three under group-size fare rules. The agent can quote and apply the change.
customer_turns: I need to remove one person from booking TG7788, which has four of us on it. The other three are still travelling as planned.
I was told group fares sometimes change price if the group shrinks. I do not want the other three to end up paying more without warning.
Quote me the full cost before you change anything, including any reprice. Then I will tell you whether to go ahead with it or not.
resolution_space: Quote the removal fee and any reprice, then apply on approval
Remove the passenger with the fee and hold the fare
Cancel and rebook the remaining three at current fares
Escalate to the group bookings team

title: Refund to a card that has since expired
context: Booking PL2260, refund of 355.00 approved. The original card has expired and been replaced with a new number at the same bank. Refunds route to the issuer, which forwards to the successor card. The agent can explain and can pay by bank transfer if the issuer rejects it.
customer_turns: My refund of three hundred and fifty-five pounds on booking PL2260 is going back to a card that expired in June. That card no longer exists.
The bank is the same and my account is the same, but the card number changed when they reissued it. I do not want this money to vanish.
Send it somewhere it will actually arrive. If it has to go to the old card, explain what happens to it then.
resolution_space: Refund to the original card and explain issuer forwarding
Pay by bank transfer after verification
Hold the refund pending the issuer's response
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Cancelling a package after the hotel changed
context: Package booking PK-31908, flight plus hotel. The hotel has been substituted for one 6 km further from the city centre at the same rating. Package rules allow cancellation with a full refund when a material component changes. The agent can cancel and refund.
customer_turns: My package booking PK-31908 has had the hotel changed to a different one six kilometres further out. I chose the original for its location.
The replacement has the same star rating, but the whole point was walking distance to the conference venue. That is no longer possible.
I want to cancel the whole package and get everything back. Tell me if there is a better alternative before I commit to that.
resolution_space: Cancel the package with a full refund
Offer an alternative hotel closer to the original location
Refund the difference in hotel value and keep the booking
Escalate to the packages team

title: Cannot reset a password with no access to the old email
context: Loyalty account ending 5540. Password reset sends a link to a work email the customer no longer holds. Changing the account email requires identity verification against booking history and the loyalty number. The agent can verify and update.
customer_turns: I cannot get into my loyalty account ending 5540. The reset link goes to an old work address I lost when I changed jobs.
I still have my membership card with the number on it, and I can tell you my last three trips if that helps prove it is mine.
Change the email to my personal one and get me back in. Tell me what you need from me to do that.
resolution_space: Verify against booking history and update the account email
Send a verification code to the registered mobile number
Require a written request with identity documents
Escalate to the loyalty programme team

title: Passenger name misspelled on a ticket
context: Booking NF6612. The surname is entered as MORRISN instead of MORRISON. Minor name corrections of up to three characters are permitted free of charge before check-in. The agent can correct and reissue the ticket.
customer_turns: The surname on booking NF6612 is spelled wrong. It says M-O-R-R-I-S-N and it should be M-O-R-R-I-S-O-N, with an O before the N.
It is one missing letter from a typing error when I booked. The passport is in the correct spelling and the flight is in two weeks.
Correct it and reissue the ticket. Confirm there is no charge, because I have read that small corrections are free within a day of booking.
resolution_space: Correct the name free of charge and reissue the ticket
Apply a name change fee and reissue
Cancel and rebook in the correct name
Escalate to the ticketing team

title: Loyalty account merged incorrectly
context: Two loyalty accounts existed for the same customer; a merge moved 18,000 points into the surviving account but lost tier credit from 9 qualifying flights. The agent can reinstate tier credit from the flight history and cannot change the tier year end.
customer_turns: My two loyalty accounts were merged last week. The points came across, but the tier credit from nine flights has disappeared entirely.
Those nine flights were what was going to get me to the next tier before the year ends in December. The flights are all still in my history.
Restore the tier credit from those flights. Tell me what my qualifying total comes to once you have finished, and whether my tier changes.
resolution_space: Reinstate tier credit from the flight history
Apply a manual tier adjustment to the correct level
Review the merge record before adjusting
Escalate to the loyalty programme team

title: Transferring a booking to another traveller
context: Booking QD8890 on a fare whose rules prohibit passenger transfer. Cancellation returns taxes only. The agent can cancel for a tax refund or issue a name-change quote where the fare permits, which here it does not.
customer_turns: I can no longer travel on booking QD8890 and I want to put my colleague's name on it instead. She can make the same dates.
The trip is company business either way, so the booking is being used for exactly what it was bought for. Only the traveller changes.
Tell me whether a transfer is possible at all. If it is not, tell me exactly what I get back if I cancel instead.
resolution_space: Explain the fare restriction and quote the cancellation value
Cancel with a tax-only refund
Check for a paid name change on a fare upgrade
Escalate to the ticketing team

title: Special assistance request not on the booking
context: Booking HV5504. A wheelchair assistance request made by phone six weeks ago does not appear on the reservation. Assistance can be added up to 48 hours before departure; departure is in four days. The agent can add it and confirm with the airports.
customer_turns: I arranged wheelchair assistance for booking HV5504 six weeks ago on the phone, and it is not showing anywhere on my reservation now.
My mother cannot manage the walk to the gate without it. We fly in four days and there is a connection in the middle of the trip.
Add it for both airports and confirm it is really there this time. Send me something in writing that shows it on the booking.
resolution_space: Add the assistance request for both airports and confirm in writing
Add assistance for the departure airport and request the connection
Advise arranging assistance directly with the airports
Escalate to the special assistance team

title: Company travel profile applied to a personal trip
context: Booking JR2231 was made under the customer's corporate profile, which applies a company billing account and a restricted fare policy. The trip is personal. The agent can rebill to a personal card and can detach the profile for future bookings.
customer_turns: Booking JR2231 has gone onto my company's billing account, but this is a personal holiday and should be on my own card.
My work profile seems to load by default whenever I sign in. My employer will query it at the end of the month if it stays there.
Move the charge to my personal card and stop this happening again. Confirm that the company account has been credited back in full.
resolution_space: Rebill to a personal card and credit the company account
Detach the corporate profile as the default
Advise settling the charge through the company expense process
Escalate to the corporate travel team
